family_name: Bradford Supertel Faced - Heavy Duty Perforated

spec.description:
Bradford Supertel Faced - Heavy Duty Perforated is a
high-density (32kg/m3) glasswool insulation blanket and board faced with a
factory-applied Heavy Duty Perforated aluminium foil (Thermofoil HD Perf).
Specifically developed for internal HVAC duct lining, acoustic attenuators, and
visible concrete under-soffit linings, the perforated foil face allows sound
waves to enter the glasswool core for maximum acoustic absorption while
retaining fibres and providing a durable, wipeable, and reflective finish. It
delivers superior acoustic NRC ratings while meeting strict fire requirements.
features:
32kg/m3 high-density glasswool core delivers exceptional acoustic
sound absorption

Heavy Duty Perforated foil facing allows sound entry while
preventing air-stream fibre erosion

High acoustic performance with sound
absorption NRC up to 0.90 - 1.05

Ideal for internal HVAC duct lining,
silencers, plant rooms, and carpark soffits

Non-combustible glasswool core
complying with AS 1530.1

Early Fire Hazard properties complying with
AS/NZS 1530.3 (0/0/0/0-1)

Thermal performance ratings from R0.7 to R3.0 in
accordance with AS/NZS 4859.1

Manufactured from up to 65% recycled glass
using bio-soluble FBS-1 formulation

Durable, semi-rigid construction easy to
cut and impale over insulation pins

Maximum service operating temperature up
to 150°C (faced)

install:
Clean internal metal duct or
concrete ceiling substrate

Weld or glue insulation pins at 300mm to 400mm
centres

Impale the Supertel Perforated board or blanket over pins with the
perforated foil face facing into the air stream or room

Secure firmly with
metal retaining clips / speed washers

Butt all edges tightly together to
eliminate acoustic flanking

Secure edges with metal channel, angle trims, or
perforated foil tape

For internal HVAC ducting, ensure air velocities do not
exceed manufacturer rating
selection_checklist:
Confirm acoustic
absorption is required (perforated foil allows sound absorption into core)

Note: Not suitable as a condensation vapour barrier (perforations allow
moisture passage)
Verify air velocity in ductwork is within allowable limits

Specify
insulation pins, speed clips, and edge angles
accessories:
Insulation
weld pins and speed clips
limitations:
Not suitable as a vapour barrier or in moist/wet environments
due to perforations

Not
designed for direct exposure to driving rain or outdoor weathering

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Supertel Faced - Heavy Duty
Perforated is a 32 kg/m3 density glasswool blanket and board faced with
Thermofoil Heavy Duty Perforated aluminium foil. Engineered for internal HVAC
duct lining, acoustic silencers, and exposed carpark soffits, the
micro-perforated foil allows sound waves to enter the high-density glasswool
core (NRC up to 1.05) while shielding the fibres from air erosion.
Non-combustible to AS 1530.1 and thermal rated from R0.7 to R3.0, it provides a
wipeable, light-reflective, and fire-safe acoustic liner for commercial air
handling and plant spaces.
